def process(mmc7, mmc1) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df7 = mmc7.copy()
    df1 = mmc1.copy()

    # Parse numeric score
    df7['APP_Z_score_num'] = pd.to_numeric(df7['APP_Z_score'], errors='coerce')

    # Find the patient (idx) with the minimum APP-Z score
    min_row = df7.loc[df7['APP_Z_score_num'].idxmin()][['idx', 'APP_Z_score_num']]
    min_idx = min_row['idx']

    # Bring age from mmc1
    df1_small = df1[['idx', 'Age']].copy()
    df1_small['Age_num'] = pd.to_numeric(df1_small['Age'], errors='coerce')

    out = (
        pd.DataFrame([{'idx': min_idx, 'APP_Z_score': float(min_row['APP_Z_score_num'])}])
        .merge(df1_small[['idx', 'Age_num']], on='idx', how='left')
        .rename(columns={'Age_num': 'Age'})
    )

    # Return as a one-row table (Age may be float if missing; caller will cast)
    return out
